name: Contact Reveal Card
description: A single identity string that reveals a different highlighted slice as you hover or select icons below it — profile, website, email, and Instagram each spotlight their own substring with a matching caption.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Hover an icon to preview, click to select — the highlighted text and caption follow
variations.description: Hovering an icon previews which slice of the identity string it maps to; clicking commits the selection so it also works on touch. The highlighted span and its dashed underline animate width/position with a layout spring, the caption crossfades, and the icon row's hover-dim effect is pure CSS via :has/:not/:hover.

props.name: text
props.description: The full identity string every field highlights a slice of. Defaults to "kumail@creatifly.co".

props.name: fields
props.description: Icon + label + highlight range list. Defaults to Profile / Website / Email / Instagram, each mapped to a substring of `text`.

props.name: fields[].icon
props.description: HugeIcons icon component rendered in the icon row.

props.name: fields[].label
props.description: Caption shown under the text when this field is active.

props.name: fields[].highlight
props.description: Character range [start, end) of `text` this field highlights.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the root wrapper.

features: Selection state splits into a hover preview (previewKey) and a committed selection (selectedKey) so touch devices work the same as hover — click always commits
The three text spans share a layout spring so the dashed-underline highlight resizes and repositions smoothly across differently-sized substrings, no remount
Caption crossfades on change with a short fade + slide, keyed by the active field
Icon row hover-dim (non-hovered icons fade to 45% opacity) is done with zero JS listeners — a scoped inline <style> block using :has/:not/:hover
Active icon color and the text/caption pairing are the only pieces driven by React state; all idle/hover chrome is plain CSS
